messages:
Lina (Design): Quick design check — A/B toggle in rollout inspector is visually fine but screen reader reads "button" twice and doesn't say which state is active. Also keyboard tab order puts the 'Snapshot name' after the toggle which is confusing. Jordan (PM): repro steps? which SR? can you paste transcript? link to fig: https://figma.com/file/abc123/rollout-ui (frame "Inspector / AB Toggle") Lina (Design): VoiceOver macOS + Safari and NVDA+Firefox. VO says "Toggle" then the snapshot name, but not "selected". Keyboard: tab -> toggle -> press space, focus jumps to the next button not stays on the toggle. Omar (Eng): sounds like we're using a div+onclick with role="button" and programmatic state. I'll swap to a proper input type=radio segmented pattern so browsers handle keyboard focus for us. Priya (A11y): recommend using role="tablist" with aria-selected or a radio group for mutually exclusive variants. Ensure aria-checked/aria-selected is updated and add aria-live="polite" for state changes. Also make sure toggle is reachable with arrow keys when it's a segmented control. Jordan (PM): microcopy suggestion: left segment label "Control (baseline)" right "Variant A" and persistent sublabel under snapshot: "Snapshot: baseline-2026-03-22-14:02UTC". Thoughts? Lina (Design): I like persistent sublabel. Also propose trimming the snapshot ID in UI to "baseline · Mar 22 14:02 UTC" but keep full ID in the audit modal on hover. Omar (Eng): implementation plan: change markup to ```
``` I'll add keyboard handlers: left/right arrows to move, space/enter to activate, and ensure focus stays on the selected radio. Priya (A11y): add aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen element that reads "Snapshot: baseline, created Mar 22st by Lina" for SR users. Also ensure color contrast for selected segment and focus ring 3: white outline + brand color meets 4.5:1. Lina (Design): for timeline history, should we treat A/B toggles as major events? my call: A/B on/off is major; minor allocation tweaks are minor. Proposed UX: show A/B toggles as top-level entries with a chevron to reveal allocation steps. Jordan (PM): agreed. Also request: when user hovers a timeline entry show a small "view diff" pill that opens the snapshot compare modal. Omar (Eng): backend can tag events with kind:major/minor. I'll surface that. We'll add a query param ?show_minor=true for the history endpoint. audit-bot: audit event recorded: user=linas, action=created_snapshot, snapshot_id=baseline-2026-03-22-14-02 Jordan (PM): next steps: Omar to open PR for semantic control + keyboard by EOD, Lina to upload updated fig, Priya to do quick pass on the mock. I'll create a ticket to keep timeline change granularity explicit. Priya (A11y): thumbs up. I'll add checklist item: "AB segmented control: role=radiogroup OR tablist, aria-selected/checked, arrow-key nav, aria-describedby snapshot details."
